Name: Daily_ A Reshade Preset
Author: sakuracake
Description:
[size=4][b]大家好，这是我发布的第一款mod，是一个Reshade滤镜预设。
Hello everyone, this is the first mod I released, it is a Reshade filter preset.
[/b][/size]这个预设源自于我自己调的用来拍视频的梦核风滤镜，看的时间长了再切回原版才发觉原版的颜色是在太亮了，于是稍加改动，调了一个适合日常使用的滤镜，就是现在这个。（哈哈第一次发布mod好紧张啊擦汗）
This preset is derived from the Dreamcore filter that I adjusted myself for shooting videos. After watching it for a long time and switching back to the original version, I realized that the color of the original version was too bright, so I made some slight changes and adjusted it to a color that is suitable for daily use. The filter used is this one. (Haha, I was so nervous when I released a mod for the first time)



[b]Reshade安装：[/b]
[list=1]
[*]下载最新的 ReShade﻿。https://reshade.me/#download
[*]运行安装程序，并在出现提示时选择《Stardew Valley》。
[*]选择OpenGL。
[*]安装着色器资源。
[/list]确保安装了这个效果：
• qUINT by Marty McFly

[b]预设安装：[/b]
[list=1]
[*]下载预设并将 .ini 文件拖到星露谷物语根文件夹中。.../steam/steamapps/common/Stardew Valley
[*]游戏中按HOME键打开ReShade，然后从下拉菜单中选择 daily 预设。
[/list]
